# PGC repository instructions

Follow the repository-wide rules in `AGENTS.md`.

Use the maintained documentation index at `docs/README.md`:

- `docs/APP_ARCHITECTURE.md` defines system and code boundaries.
- `docs/LEAGUE_AND_APP_GUIDE.md` is required reading before league-affecting
  work.
- `docs/DEVELOPMENT_AND_OPERATIONS.md` defines setup, verification, deployment,
  and recovery workflows.

Do not treat legacy code structure as permission to violate the current
boundaries. Do not edit `src/routeTree.gen.ts` or `convex/_generated/`.
